units.known_address_notes: Zokyo report audited TokenSaleETH.sol, TokenSaleUSDB.sol and Admin.sol; the code hard-codes Blast USDB (0x4300...0003) and one finding is 'USDB address refers to a test chain', so chain = Blast (zap.tech launchpad also runs Base 8453). zap.tech front end (main.b46e8bbe.js) exposes only network ids (REACT_APP_BLAST_NETWORK_ID 81457, REACT_APP_BASE_NETWORK_ID 8453) and no contract addresses; no docs/address book; audited repo private. Admin/TokenSale addresses unpublished -> PARTIAL.

units.titles: Users can claim past their allowed_amount via cumulative cap bypass
units.known_address_notes: Oak Nov-2025 audit of a CosmWasm reward-claim contract (exec.rs/state; cumulative allowed_amount cap). Chain confirmed as ZIGChain; the ZIG Rewards Program went live 2025-11-05 and finalized 2026-05-03 via hub.zigchain.com, i.e. the code was deployed. ZIGChain/audits repo holds only the PDF; ZIGChain/zigchain-registry has no reward contract entry; docs/claim page gives no address; no ZIGChain Blockscout-style search with contract labels. Exact zig1... instance unpublished -> PARTIAL.

Pashov report names repository curio-research/flagship-contracts (game contracts, 'game fee handling'). GitHub API: curio-research/flagship-contracts = 404 (deleted/private); funding and product sources (curio.gg, keystone, treaty-contracts) publish no deployment addresses; the studio ships games on its own game-server stack with no public explorer. No audited contract address obtainable -> PARTIAL.
